newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed, distant months up.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed, distant months up.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed on Friday as technical buying, especially in distant months helped prices rebound from early lows, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.7 yen per kg lower to 1.2 yen firmer. Benchmark February was 1.0 yen firmer at 140.6 yen.
Activity was lacklustre amid a dearth of fresh incentives.

The market opened mostly weaker, but technical buying emerged due to the dollar's further dip against the yen, the traders said. Relatively lower prices in Tokyo compared with levels in rubber producing countries also stimulated moderate buying, they said.
